steps.content: You go to the edge of the deck and call out.
Before long, a familiar figure surfaces from the water.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Thank goodness... you're all right. Did you know about the commotion just now? Any changes underwater?
Pylgia nods, then shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: But... the water's murky... Too many... formless things.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I almost caught up to it, but it disappeared. I only saw a blurry shadow.
It's rare to see Pylgia on edge. She seems to be blaming herself for losing the culprit that attacked the ship.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Don't worry about the monster for now. The collision threw some of the crew into the sea. Captain Edmond wants you to bring them back.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Yes, I saw them. Found two, they're back on deck. But the others...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I'll keep looking. At least, I'll bring back the bodies.
Pylgia raises a hand and makes a wiping motion across her face, as if to brush away her unease for your sake. She gives you a faint, strained smile.
The next second, she disappears beneath the waves.
